Original note: The rules an employer's contribution to an approved superannuation fund feeds (W-238e). No rule reads employer.fund for it in a condition. PERQ-EMPLOYER-CONTRIBUTION adds up every employer contribution to a recognised provident fund, the notified pension scheme and an approved superannuation fund and charges the excess over its limit (S2 s.17(1)(h); 1961 s.17(2)(vii); D-126); PERQ-EMPLOYER-ACCRETION charges the accretion on that excess (S2 s.17(1)(i); 1961 s.17(2)(viia); D-127). Neither reads employer.fund in a condition: EmployerContributionNode reaches both with every contribution (W-238e).
displayName: The employer's contribution to an approved superannuation fund
